digest.component_or_area: reconciler backend architecture and ADR documentation
propositions: ADR 0035 contains three or four stale assertions that the first real second backend is out of scope, all now falsified by epic e369 landing Jira Data Center ahead of the GitHub adapter

TicketTransport declares six members but the reconciler calls twenty-one distinct methods on transport, with twelve absent from DC transport and no Protocol declaration, causing silent runtime failures masked by unit tests
RemoteRef.instance is presented in ADR 0035 as a distinguishing mechanism but is never constructed in production code, only in test helpers, creating a gap between intended design and reality
The documented user guide commands for DC backend selection and extra installation must be validated by execution against a live Jira DC harness, not assumed to work from static verification

ADR 0035's claim that the backend contract suite certifies a backend is conditional on both port completeness and typed parameters, a condition not currently enforced by mypy on unannotated transport parameters
